description: Public-sector jobs: federal through USAJobs (your free key), state and city/county NEOGOV portals (governmentjobs.com, one JSON call per search term), New York State and NYC listings, Maryland JobAps, Oregon's Workday, Florida's SAP site, Philadelphia's SmartRecruiters. The big states/cities that run their own portals (California, Texas, Chicago, Phoenix, Dallas, Austin, Virginia) are watch entries.
source: built 2026-10-11 for jobkit v0.3; every NEOGOV tenant answered loadJobsOnMaps that day (postings on the board in the note). Not on NEOGOV / not reachable that day: California (CalCareers, ASP.NET), Texas (CAPPS Taleo), New York State (own site, registered as html_links), NYC (own site, html_links), Chicago (Taleo), Phoenix, Dallas, Austin, Miami-Dade, Maricopa, San Francisco, Atlanta, Milwaukee, Charlotte, Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville, Salt Lake City, Boise, Kansas City, Omaha, Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Baltimore (no public NEOGOV tenant under the obvious names).
